title: TDR Door Rail
description:
A longer version of CRL's 4" Wedge-Lock tapered door rail: 36-3/4", one inch over the standard, with the pivot set at 3-5/8" to match the newest competitor 36" doors, for openings where the door needs extra clearance. Customers were already ordering this size as a custom rail at a steady rate, so we turned it into a stocked family of rails with matching 37" headers.

Most of the work was analysis and setup: sizing demand from custom-rail sales, choosing which finishes and lock options to stock, setting stocking levels at the service centers that sell the most, and writing the product listings.

metrics.label: Custom 36-3/4" rails sold before it became a stock item
New SKUs: rails and matching headers

brief.label: Problem
brief.text: Openings that need extra door clearance relied on custom-length rails, with custom lead times.

brief.label: Solution
brief.text: A stocked 36-3/4" rail with a 3-5/8" pivot setback, in five finishes with and without locks, plus matching 37" single-door headers.

brief.label: Value
brief.text: The patented Wedge-Lock system, available off the shelf at this size: a door can be prepared for installation in under ten minutes.

brief.label: Evidence
brief.text: Custom-rail sales history showed steady demand at this length, enough to justify stocking it.
